items.name: style
items.title: JDS style
items.description: Neutral light and dark themes, status colors, motion keyframes, and shared utilities.

items.name: utils
items.title: Icons and motion
items.description: Semantic icon map and motion presets shared by every component.

items.name: base-stone
items.title: Stone base
items.description: Tints the gray scale stone (hue 60). Install after @jds/style, before a color preset.

items.name: base-zinc
items.title: Zinc base
items.description: Tints the gray scale zinc (hue 286). Install after @jds/style, before a color preset.

items.name: base-slate
items.title: Slate base
items.description: Tints the gray scale slate (hue 257). Install after @jds/style, before a color preset.

items.name: color-blue
items.title: Blue primary
items.description: Sets --primary and --ring to blue. Install after @jds/style.

items.name: color-violet
items.title: Violet primary
items.description: Sets --primary and --ring to violet. Install after @jds/style.

items.name: color-rose
items.title: Rose primary
items.description: Sets --primary and --ring to rose. Install after @jds/style.

items.name: color-emerald
items.title: Emerald primary
items.description: Sets --primary and --ring to emerald. Install after @jds/style.

items.name: color-amber
items.title: Amber primary
items.description: Sets --primary and --ring to amber. Install after @jds/style.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: Scroll container for a chat thread. Stays pinned to the bottom while tokens stream and lets go when the user scrolls up.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A single turn from the user or the assistant, with hover-revealed actions.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: Composer for chat and agent apps. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, paste or drop files, stop while streaming.

items.name: prompt-input-mic
items.title: Dictation
items.description: Dictation for the prompt input. Speech is transcribed into the textarea as you talk, so it can be reviewed before sending.

items.name: response
items.title: Response
items.description: Markdown renderer that is safe to stream. Closes unterminated syntax as it arrives and highlights code with Shiki.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: Model thinking, open while it streams, then collapsed to a one-line summary with the time it took.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool Call
items.description: What the agent called, with what input, and what came back. States match AI SDK tool parts.

items.name: approval
items.title: Approval
items.description: Human-in-the-loop gate. The agent pauses on an irreversible action until the user approves or denies it.

items.name: agent-steps
items.title: Agent Steps
items.description: Plan and progress for a multi-step run: what's done, what's running, what's next.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Inline numbered citations with hover previews, and a strip of source cards.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: Follow-up prompts as a row of chips.

items.name: shimmer
items.title: Shimmer
items.description: In-progress text and a typing indicator for the gap before the first token.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: Choose the model for the next message. A quiet trigger for the prompt toolbar; the menu says what each model is for.

items.name: branch
items.title: Branch
items.description: Step through versions of a response after regenerating. New versions are selected as they arrive.

items.name: context-meter
items.title: Context Meter
items.description: How full the context window is. A small ring for the toolbar that shifts to warning at 80% and destructive at 95%, with a breakdown on hover.

items.name: prompt-input-mentions
items.title: Mentions
items.description: Type @ in the composer to mention files, tools or agents. Keyboard first; picks show as chips and are reported for sending.

items.name: prompt-input-option-menu
items.title: Tools menu
items.description: Tools like web search or deep research folded into one toolbar menu, so they fit at any width. The trigger shows the active tool, or how many are on.

items.name: prompt-input-scope
items.title: Scope
items.description: Tell the agent which parts of the product it may work on. A context label and a multi-select of modules in the composer footer; nothing selected means everything.

items.name: artifact
items.title: Artifact
items.description: A generated document or file in its own panel beside the chat, opened from a card in the message.

items.name: agent-panel
items.title: Agent Panel
items.description: A configurable agent side panel: docked or floating, left or right, card, page or glass surface, three entrance motions, and chat/voice modes.

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice Orb
items.description: Presence for a voice agent, drawn in the primary color. Ten variants: particle mesh, glowing ring, twisting ribbons, soft aura, circular bars, halftone dots, three WebGL shaders (plasma, liquid and glass), and a minimal dot for small spots. All share the same states, speed, glow and sensitivity, and react to voice level. Tune one in the Studio.

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform
items.description: Live spectrum bars for microphone input or agent speech.

items.name: push-to-talk
items.title: Push to Talk
items.description: Hold to speak with pointer or the Space key. The ring grows with input level so users know they're heard.

items.name: live-transcript
items.title: Live Transcript
items.description: Rolling speech transcript per speaker. Interim text is dimmed until recognition commits it.

items.name: voice-picker
items.title: Voice Picker
items.description: Choose a synthetic voice, with a spoken preview for each option.

items.name: call-controls
items.title: Call Controls
items.description: Controls for a realtime voice session: status and timer, mute, interrupt the agent, end the call.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An image with a text fallback for users and agents.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small status label.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button or a component that looks like a button.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A container for grouped content.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides a panel.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over the page.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or shortcut.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A list of actions in a dropdown.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll container with styled scrollbars.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one value from a list.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A visual divider.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge. Can render inside a container, non-modal.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder while content loads.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between related views.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with content.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief notifications, via Sonner.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that expand one or several at a time.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout for status or warnings, inline with content.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts to confirm a destructive action.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where you are in a hierarchy, with links back up.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: An on/off choice, usually in a list of settings.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text input that filters a list of options as you type.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable command palette with groups and shortcuts.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Actions on right-click or long press.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides up from the bottom and can be swiped away.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A placeholder for empty states, with a next step.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, control, description and error, laid out consistently.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A rich preview when hovering a link or mention.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with icons, text or buttons attached.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code entry, one character per slot.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible text for a form control.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A desktop-style bar of menus.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Move between pages of results.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Completion of a known-length task.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Pick exactly one of a few options.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Choose a value within a range.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading indicator.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turn a setting on or off, taking effect immediately.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns of structured data.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggles, single or multiple choice.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a date or range.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Swipe or step through a row of cards.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Consistent form layout with native validation, built on Base UI Form.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, like quota used.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Top-level site navigation with rich dropdowns.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A numeric input with steppers, arrow keys and drag-to-scrub.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels the user can resize by dragging the divider.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls with arrow-key navigation between them.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A label on hover or focus.

items.name: voice-agent
items.title: Voice agent
items.description: A complete voice agent surface: the orb, live captions and call controls, with the agent's tool calls and transcript beside it. Style it in the Studio, pick a layout, connect your voice session.

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent run
items.description: A full support-agent turn: reasoning, a plan, a tool call, approval before a refund, a streamed answer with sources.

items.name: agent-side-panel
items.title: Agent side panel
items.description: An agent side panel over your app: chat with page context, dictation, and a hold-to-talk voice mode whose turns land back in the chat. Style the panel and orb in the Studio, bring your own composer, connect useChat.

items.name: voice-call
items.title: Voice call
items.description: A realtime call screen: connection status and timer, the orb, live captions, and mute, interrupt and end controls.

items.name: voice-session
items.title: Voice session
items.description: Push to talk with live mic level, orb states, and a rolling transcript.

items.name: chat-app
items.title: Chat app
items.description: A full chat screen: searchable conversation list, model picker and context meter in the header, and a composer you can swap for one from the Prompt Input Studio.

items.name: agent-inbox
items.title: Agent inbox
items.description: Runs that need a human. Pick one to see its steps and tool calls, then approve or deny; decided runs leave the queue.

items.name: agent-settings
items.title: Agent settings
items.description: Configure an agent: instructions, model, temperature, reply length, approval policy, tools, and voice.

items.name: agent-onboarding
items.title: Agent onboarding
items.description: Set up an agent by answering its questions. Quick replies drive the chat while a live card and progress list fill in beside it.

items.name: run-history
items.title: Run history
items.description: How agents are doing: headline stats with week-over-week change, runs per day (with a table view), and recent runs by status.
